# MT6260 (Fernvale) register map probe

Generated by regscan.py over the fernly shell. Each 64 KiB block is probed at its first word; blocks that answered are then dumped 16 words deep, read twice to spot live counters.

## Coarse scan 0x82c00000-0x82cfffff step 0x1000

Unmapped addresses read as 0 on this bus, so a block counts as alive when any of its first four words is non-zero.
